snippet.title: ARO: Tales In The Dome Trailer | 2D Hand Drawn Metroidvania Game
snippet.description:
ARO: Tales in the Dome is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure game developed by 60K Game Studio.

Play as Aro, and explore a mysterious elemental world sealed beneath a massive dome. As the journey unfolds, uncover the hidden conspiracy and face the truth about the world, the dome, and yourself.
Please add it to your Wishlist if you like it: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140890/ARO_Tales_In_The_Dome
Official website: https://www.60k.ca/
